title: Publish the canonical Notion page "Shanivar Product Thesis — Protection, Awareness & Flow" with decision log
owner: Founder approves; PM maintains (no team owner in §10 list)
body:
Status: awaiting founder confirmation — do not build yet.

**Title:** Publish the canonical Notion page "Shanivar Product Thesis — Protection, Awareness & Flow" with decision log
**Epic:** Epic A (DEV-56)
**User problem:** Teams act on different readings of the thesis because there is no single source of truth.
**Hypothesis:** Not a product hypothesis — a process requirement from brief §2A.
**Scope — in:** All 11 sections listed in brief §2A; links to every DEV epic/ticket; decision log with owner/status/last-updated.
**Scope — out:** Rewriting earlier decisions without logging what changed and why; new research.
**Requirements:** Page exists, links to roadmap and DEV epics DEV-56..62; earlier decisions preserved and referenced.
**Acceptance criteria:** Every §2A section present; each epic linked; decision log has at least the 2026-10-17 entry; founder marks it approved.
**Dependencies:** None.
**Analytics:** None.
**Security/privacy:** No user data on the page. Safety rules: No breath pacing; no medical, therapeutic, energy or performance claims; teachers stay internal; self-reports are never scores or health data; no unnecessary sensitive data in analytics/logs; the protected-app list stays on the device unless the founder decides otherwise.
**Test cases:**
- Normal: Page reviewed section by section against §2A.
- Edge: A decision conflicts with an older one — both recorded with reason.
- Failure: Link to a deleted ticket — flagged in review.
- Recovery: Page restored from Notion history if overwritten.
**Owner:** Founder approves; PM maintains (no team owner in §10 list)
**Priority:** High
**Definition of done:** Code/doc reviewed; tests above pass and are linked; docs updated; telemetry verified where applicable; release gates for Epic A met. 
**Evidence:** Strategy brief 2026-10-17 §9 Epic A; links to design, implementation, test results and decisions to be added here.

title: Define the event dictionary, analytics contract and WIAC (North Star) computation
body:
Status: awaiting founder confirmation — do not build yet.

**Title:** Define the event dictionary, analytics contract and WIAC (North Star) computation
**Epic:** Epic A (DEV-56)
**User problem:** There is no analytics infrastructure (SessionReview.kt is local-only), so no outcome in the brief can be measured.
**Hypothesis:** UNVALIDATED — WIAC (Weekly Intentional Actions Completed, deduplicated across features) reflects intentional behaviour; tested by pairing with self-reported intentionality (Epic G) before treating it as truth.
**Scope — in:** Event names, properties, timestamps (UTC + local tz), dedup key, consent rule; WIAC and activation/time-to-first-value/routine completion/protection-window effectiveness/recovery definitions; routine events (created, step completed, step missed, recovered).
**Scope — out:** Choosing a vendor; dashboards (G1); building pipelines.
**Requirements:** One schema doc; each event has owner, trigger, properties, PII class; no package names of protected apps, no free text, no self-report values as scores.
**Acceptance criteria:** Doc reviewed by FE, BE, Tester, CS; every metric in brief §6 traceable to events; privacy review signed.
**Dependencies:** A2; DEV-53/54 (orbit_events, observations).
**Analytics:** This ticket defines them.
**Security/privacy:** Data minimisation review; protected-app list never sent; self-reports excluded or stored only as user-owned records, never scores. Safety rules: No breath pacing; no medical, therapeutic, energy or performance claims; teachers stay internal; self-reports are never scores or health data; no unnecessary sensitive data in analytics/logs; the protected-app list stays on the device unless the founder decides otherwise.
**Test cases:**
- Normal: Each metric computed from a sample event log.
- Edge: Same action logged by two features — counted once.
- Failure: Missing timezone — event rejected/flagged.
- Recovery: Schema versioning: old events still parse.
**Owner:** Shanivar Backend
**Priority:** Highest
**Definition of done:** Code/doc reviewed; tests above pass and are linked; docs updated; telemetry verified where applicable; release gates for Epic A met.

title: Detect and surface protection failures (service killed, permission revoked)
body:
Status: awaiting founder confirmation — do not build yet.

**Title:** Detect and surface protection failures (service killed, permission revoked)
**Epic:** Epic B (DEV-57)
**User problem:** If protection silently stops, users believe they are protected when they are not.
**Hypothesis:** Not a hypothesis — reliability requirement.
**Scope — in:** Heartbeat from FocusGuardService; detect usage-access/overlay permission loss (LocalProtectionController.canEnforce); show 'protection is off' state; crash/ANR to DEV-14 reporting.
**Scope — out:** Server-side monitoring of app usage.
**Requirements:** Never show 'protected' when not enforcing; failure visible within one poll interval.
**Acceptance criteria:** Killing the service shows off/unknown state; revoking permission shows the fix path; failure appears in crash reporting.
**Dependencies:** DEV-14, B1.
**Analytics:** protection_failure{reason}.
**Security/privacy:** No app names in logs. Safety rules: No breath pacing; no medical, therapeutic, energy or performance claims; teachers stay internal; self-reports are never scores or health data; no unnecessary sensitive data in analytics/logs; the protected-app list stays on the device unless the founder decides otherwise.
**Test cases:**
- Normal: Normal window runs end to end.
- Edge: Doze / battery saver.
- Failure: Service force-stopped.
- Recovery: User re-grants permission and protection resumes.

**Title:** Define routine completion semantics and make completion idempotent
**Epic:** Epic C (DEV-58)
**User problem:** Repeated taps, retries or sync could duplicate completions and inflate progress.
**Hypothesis:** Not a hypothesis — brief §4 requirement.
**Scope — in:** What counts as complete/missed/recovered; idempotency key per step-occurrence locally and in put_routine/sync (DEV-52, DEV-45).

**Security/privacy:** Per-user isolation via RLS. **Test cases:**
- Normal: Complete a step.
- Edge: Complete same step offline twice then sync.
- Failure: Server rejects — UI does not show success.

title: Missed-step recovery and non-punitive return
body:
Status: awaiting founder confirmation — do not build yet.

**Title:** Missed-step recovery and non-punitive return
**Epic:** Epic C (DEV-58)
**User problem:** After missing steps, users face guilt or confusing state and abandon routines.
**Hypothesis:** UNVALIDATED — offering a smaller next step after a miss improves recovery after missed days; tested by recovery metric (A3).
**Scope — in:** Missed state, 'start smaller today' option, no streak shaming, no endless reminder loop.
**Scope — out:** Gamified penalties.
**Requirements:** A missed action never creates a loop or unrecoverable state.
**Acceptance criteria:** After 1, 3 and 7 missed days the app offers a clear way back; copy reviewed for guilt.
**Dependencies:** C1, A3.
**Analytics:** routine_step_missed, routine_recovered.
**Security/privacy:** None beyond C1. Safety rules: No breath pacing; no medical, therapeutic, energy or performance claims; teachers stay internal; self-reports are never scores or health data; no unnecessary sensitive data in analytics/logs; the protected-app list stays on the device unless the founder decides otherwise.
**Test cases:**
- Normal: Miss one step, return.
- Edge: Miss across timezone change.
- Failure: Reminder fails to deliver.
- Recovery: User returns after 30 days.
**Owner:** Shanivar Frontend
**Priority:** High
